description: The restrictions data (kitsenduste andmed) published by Estonia's Land and Spatial Development Board map the areas where land use is restricted because of nearby infrastructure or protected features, as recorded against cadastral parcels. Contents: nationwide polygon layers of restriction zones grouped by cause, with separate files for electricity (power lines and substations), gas, district heating, telecommunications, transport (roads and railways), water supply and sewerage, chemical sites, national defence, geodetic points, land improvement systems, nature and heritage protection, pollution risk, water bodies, planning and compulsory possession areas, plus a file of rights of use. Producer: Maa- ja Ruumiamet, compiling zones registered by network owners and authorities. Coverage: all of Estonia; the combined GeoPackage (about 1.75 GB) was last modified on 9 September 2026. Format and access: a single GeoPackage of all impact areas and per-theme Shapefile and DXF downloads from a public object store; a fee calculator and parcel queries sit on the same pages. Free under the board's open data terms (source attribution). Caveats: the layers show buffers around assets, not the assets or their attributes, so the network geometry must be inferred from the zones; completeness depends on what owners have registered. Simulation uses: proxies for the routes of power, gas, heat and telecom lines where operator data are closed, for corridor analysis, co-location and hazard exposure of utility networks. Related records: the Estonian Topographic Database (data-estonia-etak-topographic-database) holds the topographic utility lines.
